rules.name: Gunboats Flotillas
rules.description: Gunboat Squadrons cost 30 points instead of 40; However the always follw the Awe and Fear rule. (Gunboats already cost 30pts, so I'm assuming they meant Gunbrig Squadrons - ed)

rules.name: Najaden
rules.description: When sailing at Battle Sails or faster, at any point in the middle of your second Rates of Knot move, you can perform a turn in addition to the maximum number of turns you are usually allowed to do,  using the yellow (narrow) side of the turn marker.

rules.name: Johan Olfert Fischer (Rule 1)
rules.description: A ship occupied by Commodore Fisher gains one re-roll of all dice used in her first broadside.

rules.name: Johan Olfert Fischer (Rule 2)
rules.description: When FIscher's flagship falls under half its ship points, he may move his command to the nearest ship in the same fleet within 20" range. After he transfers, the new ship gets one re-roll of all the dice used in its first broadside
